import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    
    if K == 0:
        print(pow(P, P - 1, MOD))
        return
    if K == 1:
        print(pow(P, P, MOD))
        return
    
    visited = [0] * P
    freq = [0] * (P + 1)  # index up to P
    
    for i in range(P):
        if not visited[i]:
            length = 0
            cur = i
            while not visited[cur]:
                visited[cur] = 1
                length += 1
                cur = (K * cur) % P
            freq[length] += 1
    
    ans = 1
    for i in range(2, P):
        if freq[i]:
            base = (freq[i] * i + 1) % MOD
            ans = (ans * pow(base, freq[i], MOD)) % MOD
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
